content.rendered: The Hawks View annual food drive will run from Tuesday, November 28th through Friday, December 8th.  Only non-perishable items please.  All food donated will be distributed by the Sherwood Elks and will stay in the Sherwood area.  Let’s work together as a Hawks View Community to make a difference! Check the Food Drive flyer for the special events, and fun goals throughout the drive.
